address_domain: All target and instruction addresses named rva are PE-relative RVAs, without an artificial-base subtraction.
local_player_index_semantics: Zero selects the primary connection; it is not a bit flag or a reliable/channel sequence.

instruction_anchors.fact: Fast archive cursor loads exactly one byte.
Advances the byte cursor by one, without alignment/reset.
Fallback reads the same raw byte into PlayerController+0x524.
Connection must equal driver+0x98 before local-player binding.
Zero index follows the primary-connection branch.
Primary branch tail-calls connection.v0x2c0 with this PlayerController and original connection.
Nonzero indices1..connection+0x50 select connection+0x48 child array at index-1.
Larger nonzero index requests a child through driver.v0x358, then calls its v0x2c0.

same_bunch_order: PackageMap SerializeNewActor at0x128613c3 consumes the actor envelope first.
ActorChannel SetActor at0x128614cf precedes InitActor at0x128614e2.
InitActor passes the same FInBunch to actor.v0x3d8 at0x1285de7e.
The base PlayerController hook consumes this raw u8 before ReadContentBlockPayload at0x128619b2.

qualification.derived_override_acceptance_rule: Allow this base tail profile only when the actual observed target-class/template candidate hook slot0x3d8 resolves to RVA0x12d4ddb0 in the exact pinned Shipping image. A class name, inherited assumption or guessed target is insufficient.
